name: Mayuzumi Mayuri
source:
Ryou's cousin and the one who invites him to the "super ojou-sama school". She's always loved Ryou and she feels that this is the last chance she has to make him fall for her, even though she's too embarrassed to confess to him. Her childhood dream is to be a bride and marry Ryou.

[spoiler]She also is in love with Sakurako, but she doesn't realize it, nor want wants to, as it conflicts with her dream of marrying Ryou.[/spoiler]

Future: In the prologue, she confesses she's marrying to someone because Yukari became Japan's president, and the law Yukari made forbidding weddings is about to come in effect. She also wanted Ryou to see her wearing a wedding dress.
